**Major expansion: Advanced meta-analysis modules and interactive workflow**

- Added support for Bayesian network meta-analysis (Stan/JAGS), survival meta-analysis, trial sequential analysis (TSA), single-group rate/meta-mean, and diagnostic accuracy meta-analysis.
- Introduced a new interactive menu system for guided workflows and clearer module selection.
- Added comprehensive R code references/workflows for advanced topics (e.g., one-stage dose–response, multilevel/multivariate meta, PRISMA/review screening, robust variance estimation).
- Expanded output to include results summaries and editable SVG/PNG plot exports, with detailed guidance for figure editing and manuscript preparation.
- Updated and reorganized documentation for easier navigation; added in-depth reference guides for all new methods and workflows.

- Updated README.md and README_ZH.md documentation.
- No changes were made to the skill's code or functionality in this release.
- Enhanced clarity and detail for users in reference and usage sections.

- Initial release of the meta-analysis skill for R-based, comprehensive meta-analysis.
- Supports all RevMan 5.x features as well as Stata metareg/mvmeta equivalents, effect size conversions, and advanced cluster-robust variance estimation.
- Enables random/fixed-effect, multilevel/multivariate, network, and Bayesian meta-analyses, plus power analysis.
- All steps output fully reproducible R code and publication-ready tables/plots; designed for both clinical and research professionals.
- Input via templates, CSV/Excel, or effect-size formats, with validation checks built in.
- Covers extensive triggers in both English and Chinese, and ensures local-only, secure processing.
